snippet.title: NILSH — Short Trailer | An Adventure Awaits
snippet.description:
NILSH is an adventure, action and exploration game set in a rich, vibrant world that, by the whims of fate, has slowly withered away over time.

The Nilsh are adorable creatures who live in harmony with the ecosystem around them. But one of them will be drawn into a mission he is not prepared for.

NILSH is a story of overcoming adversity that embraces the classic hero’s journey, drawing from a tradition found in some of the genre’s most renowned franchises, while forging its own identity through its mechanics, narrative, art direction and, above all, the charisma of its characters.

Explore an interconnected world, discover forgotten ruins, meet its inhabitants and uncover the secrets of a past that perhaps should never have been forgotten.

Add NILSH to your wishlist, join our Discord community and visit our website to learn more about the project.
